title: HTML Forms: Build a Student Registration Form
description: Practice HTML form structure by building a clean student registration form using HTML and CSS only.
author: Obaidul

homework.title: Student Registration Form Challenge
homework.description: Recreate the supplied form, then improve its visual hierarchy without JavaScript.
checks: Use a form element with a meaningful action and method.
Add labels for every form control.
Include text, email, password, date, radio, checkbox and select controls.
Create a responsive two-column layout that becomes one column on small screens.
Add visible focus styles to interactive controls.
